svg.title: Week 3 System Architecture – IaC, CI/CD & Containerization
svg.desc: Three-layer architecture: Developer/CI pipeline on top, AWS VPC with EC2 in the middle, and monitoring at the bottom. Arrows show the flow from code push through GitHub Actions to Docker Hub to EC2 deployment, with CloudWatch observing the deployed instance.
svg.text: ① test ② build ③ push
